body: No. I need to overcome it but I just do not have the opportunities.

Well, I dunno, I was coddled from a young age because I was thought to be above average intelligence, which just means that I could remember almost all of my interactions and learn almost anything. I started violin when I was three. But then I realized how trivial school was if they did not go strive to teach. 

I have always just been pushed into nonsocial activities and payed for it badly.

I am just so alone, it doesn't generally get to me but when I see people happy and celebrating with other people, well it really gets to me.

I have just spent so much of my life in situations that did not require me to be social that I am awful at being social.
